config.label: SAIHM operator endpoint
config.description: SAIHM operator endpoint. Optional: defaults to the hosted service at https://saihm.coti.global/mcp.

config.label: Self-join is ON by default: the saihm_join tool generates a non-custodial identity on this device and activates the free trial, so no master secret is needed
config.description: Self-join is ON by default: the saihm_join tool generates a non-custodial identity on this device and activates the free trial, so no master secret is needed. Set to '0' to suppress the tool.

config.label: Path to a mode-600 file holding a 64+ hex-char master secret
config.description: Path to a mode-600 file holding a 64+ hex-char master secret. Only needed if you opt out of self-join or are restoring an existing identity. Never transmitted.

config.label: Base dir for the self-join identity file ($SAIHM_HOME/free-identity
config.description: Base dir for the self-join identity file ($SAIHM_HOME/free-identity.key, mode 600). Defaults to ~/.saihm.
